Modern astronomers give the duration of the sidereal (nirayana) year as 365.256363 days, and of the tropical (sayana) year as 365.242193 days. The duration of the solar year as per the Surya Siddhanta is greater by 3.245 minutes. This has ,given rise to the errors in the tables for the annual solar return.
